questions.explanation_en: Key corrected: the official key gives option 2 (UPSC CSP 2024 answer key). A Bill for which a joint sitting has been notified does not lapse even if the Lok Sabha is dissolved (Article 108(5)); statements 1 and 2 are correct (option 2).
